events.speaker: vale
events.message: The convoy is moving east from the parts depot. Box truck in the middle. The raised walkway is ahead of it.

events.speaker: rook
events.message: Security is out. Two machine guns. They need that truck; let them come back for it.

events.speaker: sable
events.message: Truck drive is out. Load is intact. Cease fire on the truck; clear its security detail.

events.speaker: morrow
events.message: Security clear. The cooperative will collect the bulk load. Take the dispatch case beside the truck back to our van; one carrier, the rest covering.

events.speaker: sable
events.message: The inventory tag is transmitting. Get that case to the van. You can put it down with H if the carrier needs to fight.

events.speaker: vale
events.message: A patrol is following the case's inventory signal. One machine gun, two pistols. Keep the carrier moving; the west service entrance is open.

events.speaker: rook
events.message: Case aboard. Bring every surviving chassis into the bay; we can leave the patrol behind.
